description: This file defines the ConsistencyTestHarness class used for testing transactional consistency in Orleans grains. It manages transaction execution, monitors version histories, detects violations like cycles in execution order, and reports inconsistencies.

classes.name: ConsistencyTestHarness
classes.description: Class for orchestrating and verifying consistency in transactions across Orleans grains.

methods.name: ConsistencyTestHarness
methods.description: Constructor initializing the test harness with configuration options.

methods.name: RunRandomTransactionSequence
methods.description: Executes a sequence of random transactions across grains, records outcomes.

methods.name: CheckConsistency
methods.description: Analyzes collected transaction data to check for consistency violations and serializability issues.
